spec_match.rationale: Every probed surface is one the RWS wind-down actually touches or preserves: requestStorageAccessFor, requestStorageAccess, hasStorageAccess, and the 'top-level-storage-access' vs 'storage-access' permission names. The refile removed the predecessor's bogus navigator.storage.permissionState row (an API that never existed).

interactive.rationale: Live async probes render present/removed verdicts per surface on load; the page is a watch-the-wind-down instrument by design.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card's promise of detecting RWS-related entry points for migration planning.

edge_cases.rationale: Each probe can return either verdict; the headless run showed the honest mixed state (methods still present, rSAFor-only permission already not exposed).

conformance.rationale: The new v153 feature suite asserts the same removal/survivor split, including the companion rSAFor removal; the v152 suite was untouched.

runtime_evidence.rationale: deno task responsive-check v153/deprecate-and-remove-related-website-sets-rws --no-server passed desktop+mobile; screenshots read. CDP sweep read all five probe rows with zero console errors/exceptions/failed requests.

telemetry_health.rationale: Shared demo-telemetry shell captures runtime errors; probe verdicts are explicit text.

design_system.rationale: Design-system variables only; amber/rose verdict badges keep text labels and AA-compliant pairings on paper backgrounds.

accessibility.rationale: Semantic table with row headers and aria-label; verdicts are words ('still present' / 'removed / not exposed'), not colour alone.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Feature harness passed both classes; the table fits a 360px viewport without horizontal overflow.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible live status output for feature detection probes and async API results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Probe results belong in semantic table structures with textual status, not colour-only indicators.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Kept th/td semantics, added descriptive row labels explaining what each surface's presence means, and verdicts remain words.

summary: v153 refile of rws-detection-probe. Fixed a real predecessor defect: the navigator.storage.permissionState row probed an API that never existed and always displayed 'removed'; it was replaced with the two real Permissions API names ('top-level-storage-access' vs 'storage-access'), run async. Verified via the responsive harness and a CDP read of all five rows with zero console errors.
